snippet.title: Heroes of Valor - Early Access Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Heroes of Valor is out in Early Access on June 12th! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/

This is war, soldier. Pick a class, gear up, and hit the front lines. Whether you're storming beaches, piloting fighters, or holding the line with your squad, your orders are clear: fight hard, fight smart, and never back down. Enlist now! Become a Hero of Valor today!

Stay up to date with Heroes of Valor and Iceberg Interactive:
